question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is '**found**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**found**'. • It means** 'to discover something by chance'.** (अचानक या संयोग से कुछ पता लगा लेना) • *Example: This animal can be **found** [exists] all over the world.* • The given sentence expresses that the narrator discovered that he was in a totally different culture when he moved to New York to further his studies. • The other options cannot be used because the sentence is in the past tense. **Found **is the most appropriate answer. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** Correct Passage:__ *I studied at the J.J. School of Art in Mumbai, India’s premier institute __of__ (1) art and design. After two years I __moved to__ (2) New York City to further my studies. I soon __**found**__ (3) myself in a totally different culture which I embraced (4)______ willingly. Interestingly, it was in New York that I began (5)______ different cuisines. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **finding**: information that is discovered as a result of research into something. (अनुसंधान से प्राप्‍त जानकारी या निष्‍कर्ष) • **observing**: notice or perceive (something) and register it as being significant. (नोटिस या अनुभव (कुछ) और इसे महत्वपूर्ण होने के रूप में पंजीकृत करें) • **discover**: to find or learn something that nobody had found or knew before. (किसी नई बात का पता लगाना या उसे जानना) 45:T80e, The correct answer is '**most**'.
